local datum = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.DATUM
local time = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.TIME

function safe_sub(str, start_pos, end_pos)
    local value = string.sub(str, start_pos, math.min(end_pos, #str))
    return value ~= "" and value or "00"
end

local year = safe_sub(datum, 1, 4)
local month = safe_sub(datum, 5, 6)
local day = safe_sub(datum, 7, 8)
local hour = safe_sub(time, 1, 2)
local minute = safe_sub(time, 3, 4)
local second = safe_sub(time, 5, 6)

return string.format('%s-%s-%sT%s:%s:%s.000Z', year, month, day, hour, minute, second)

local function ensure_array(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return {value}
    end
    local is_array = true
    for key, _ in pairs(value) do
        if type(key) ~= "number" or math.floor(key) ~= key then
            is_array = false
            break
        end
    end
    return is_array and value or {value}
end

for _, obj in ipairs(wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.ZCDF_PACKAGES) do
    if type(obj) == "table" and obj.items then
        obj.items = ensure_array(obj.items)
    end
end
